about:
Automotive Charging & Starting LLC was founded in 2011 by Brian Webb in Idaho Falls, Idaho. Webb brought over 20 years of experience from AC&S to the venture, which operates as an independently owned and operated shop serving the local community and surrounding region.

The company provides battery sales, service, and recycling, along with repair services for alternators, starters, generators, and DC motors. It maintains a large inventory of parts from OEM and aftermarket suppliers such as Delco, Bosch, Denso, and Mitsubishi, and offers same-day completion on most jobs unless parts must be ordered. A 24-hour emergency service, free battery checks, free installation, and a battery buy-back program round out the service lineup.

Customers span automotive, commercial, industrial, agricultural, marine, and recreational sectors. The shop services all major vehicle manufacturers, including brands from Japan (Acura, Toyota, Honda), Europe (Audi, BMW, Mercedes-Benz), and the United States (Ford, Chevrolet, Ram, Jeep), as well as heavy-duty trucks, agricultural equipment, and marine deep-cycle applications.

Webb started the business to deliver genuine value and outstanding service to the community, emphasizing a no-hassle guarantee and free diagnosis of no-start conditions to recommend the least expensive solution rather than selling unnecessary parts.
